name: Teri Bowers
occupation: Lincoln County commissioner (serving through the current term, which ends in January 2027)
prior_offices: Lincoln County commissioner (won the November 2022 general election; listed on the official commissioners page)
background: Teri Bowers is a Lincoln County commissioner, serving through the end of the current term in January 2027. She won the November 2022 general election, and the official commissioners page lists her as a member. SVI-NEWS reported that she did not file for re-election. Incoming commissioner Jake Long takes office in January 2027.
